notes.title: Patch Notes: Quadrillion Update
notes.notes:
Patch Notes: Quadrillion Update

Reworked map – improved design and optimized environment
Adjusted missions – reworked objectives and improved task flow
Added voice acting – new voice recordings for characters
NPCs – interactive characters added to the game world
Added cutscenes – new story sequences enhancing the atmosphere
AI improvements:
Added Shooter AI – enemies now use firearms
Added Fighter AI – improved melee combat behavior
Reworked Zombie AI – more realistic undead behavior
Linearized map – adjusted design for smoother gameplay
New sounds – enhanced audio effects for better immersion

notes.title: Quadrillion Update #02
notes.notes:
Greetings, players!

We have the latest updates on the progress of our game Quadrillion.

Updates:
Enhanced gameplay and expanded storyline: We’ve simplified the map for smoother gameplay and expanded the storyline, immersing you in the dramatic events of World War I.
Voiced NPCs: Your interaction with the game world will feel more authentic thanks to fully voiced characters.
Advanced AI for combat: Get ready to face challenging opponents that will put your tactical skills to the test.
Engaging quests and cutscenes: Each quest comes with captivating effects and cinematic cutscenes that draw you straight into the action.
Challenges for both logic and action lovers: The game combines logical puzzles with intense combat in the gritty conditions of the trenches.
We’ll keep you updated with more news soon. Thank you for your support, and we hope you’re as excited as we are!


Best regards,
the dedicated team of two developers from Re:Wolves studio TT

notes.title: Quadrillion Update #01
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863165/b077bd8e3cee77dd9a03656d588a095807bc97c9.gif[/img]
Update #01 information:

We've updated the graphics, especially the fog and effects (see attached gif or video).
[previewyoutube=2r8CJQoqQmQ;full][/previewyoutube]
We reworked the first map and significantly enlarged it.
Added a new weapon – the Nagant 1895 revolver.
Introduced the ability to adjust FOV (field of view).
Rewriting a few key scripts was a challenge, but we successfully completed it!
Conclusion:
We continue working at full capacity and with enthusiasm, especially as we see how our project is improving! In the next update, we'll showcase our improved AI, especially our new shooter AI.

Thank you for your attention.
Best regards,
RE:wolves Studio
